adjudication.rationale: The new embed loading view unconditionally calls `document.location.reload()` every 30s (app/views/embed/loading.html.erb). If `TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed(embed_url)` keeps returning nil (e.g., retrieval job fails or never succeeds), the client will reload forever with no terminal/error state or backoff. This also conflicts with the 60s Redis throttle in `TopicRetriever#retrieved_recently?`, meaning the page will reload (and enqueue `:retrieve_topic`) twice as often as retrieval can occur, causing needless repeated requests/jobs.
